name: ContactChannelValidation

storage_validation: input must be a string within bounds.json contact_channels.value_text pre-normalization bound
remove only leading/trailing code points from the pinned UNICODE_MATCH_V1 White_Space set; do not otherwise rewrite the operator value for storage
reject empty result, NUL, CR, LF, C0/C1 control characters and any second logical line
parse the complete remaining value as exactly one addr-spec using Python stdlib email.headerregistry.Address(addr_spec=value); parsing failure is CHANNEL_INVALID
do not perform DNS, SMTP, network, mailbox-existence or deliverability checks
persist the trimmed accepted value_text and compute match_key separately through UNICODE_MATCH_V1; the matching key is evidence and does not replace the address actually stored

rules: Contact and channel must both be active
rerun EMAIL_CHANNEL_V1 syntax validation just in time
return usable value_text only after successful validation
do not contact DNS, SMTP or any external email service
failure blocks only the communication-dependent action and never invalidates the Contact/Ticket/Task/Objective/Spare Need/Spare Request

result.rule: MISSING/ARCHIVED/INVALID are ordinary prerequisite states for a recipient-requiring workflow, not reasons to invalidate the underlying operational entity

determinism.rule: EMAIL_CHANNEL_V1 accepted/rejected golden vectors must produce identical results on supported Python 3.13 and 3.14 lines
determinism.upgrade: if a future supported Python/parser change alters an accepted golden vector, SOMA must version the channel policy or add an explicit compatibility shim before release rather than silently changing stored-channel eligibility

security_rules: recipient values are data only and never interpolated into HTML, shell, SQL or header text without the owning serializer's escaping rules
CR/LF/control rejection prevents recipient-header injection through the master channel value
LLD-09 generated artifact stores its own immutable recipient Contact identity and exact address snapshot effective at generation time
